JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.title: Jaina
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.description:
Lord Admiral of [blue]Kul Tiras[/blue] and former Archmage of the Kirin Tor.
Forged by the ashes of Theramore, she commands arcane, fire, and frost to protect all she holds dear.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.cardsModifierDescr: Jaina cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.eventDeathPreventi: I will not lose anyone else... For my allies and Kul Tiras, I must endure!
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.aromaPrinciple: [sine][blue]Face the storm... Never run again... Protect those I hold dear...[/blue][/sine]
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.goldMonologue: [sine]This fortune could reforge the Kul Tiran fleet and rebuild Theramore...[/sine]
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.banter.alive.endTu: The tide waits for no one. Your move.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.bestiaryQuote: No tome of the Kirin Tor records this creature... I have yet to best it.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.unlockText: Play a single run with [blue]{Prerequisite}[/blue] to unlock this character.
